articles.title: Photon held a funeral for mobile apps. Now it has $4.5M to help replace them with agents
articles.summary: The startup helps developers build AI agents that work over iMessage, SMS/RCS, email, and other messaging platforms. It's a bet that consumers will increasingly use agents instead of downloading apps.

articles.title: Hearing tech startup Legato launches its AI hearing glasses
articles.summary: The glasses stem from the startup’s goal of making hearing care more accessible by addressing the cost, comfort, and stigma associated with traditional hearing aids.

articles.title: Audible’s new features let you explore book worlds — and use AI to talk to characters
articles.summary: Audible is rolling out new features that help listeners keep track of characters, explore places and imagery mentioned in books, and even interact with characters using generative AI.

articles.title: The new Kindle ditches the bezel in a push toward a smaller, lighter e-reader
articles.summary: The new Kindle lineup features its lightest and thinnest designs yet, with a sleek, front-flush display that eliminates bezels for good.

articles.title: Amazon introduces Kindle Click, a $35 remote for turning pages
articles.summary: The compact Bluetooth remote is designed to let readers turn pages without touching their Kindle.

articles.title: Satlyt, founded by a former Google and SpaceX product manager, raises $8M to run AI on satellites
articles.summary: Satlyt wants to be the Android of orbital computing, offering open software that works on many companies' satellites, versus SpaceX's closed, all-in-one iPhone-style approach.

articles.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Argon, called its most powerful model yet
articles.summary: Google has released its latest Gemini model, marketing it as a workhorse for coding and cybersecurity work.

articles.title: The Pentagon taps Elon Musk and Palmer Luckey to help decide what the military should do next
articles.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth just launched a 120-day study on the future of warfare, led by Elon Musk, Palmer Luckey, and Newt Gingrich, and while it makes sense given their ties to the administration, critics could point out that Musk's and Luckey's companies already sell the kinds of technology the study is likely to recommend.

articles.title: Valor, Atreides, and Sequoia back AI startup Flow Engineering at $750M valuation
articles.summary: Flow Engineering, which is bringing AI agents to hardware design, also landed Roelof Botha as an angel investor and board member.

articles.title: Factory CEO just accused his VC board adviser of spying for Cognition
articles.summary: VC Chris Degnan and former board adviser to Factory AI has taken a job as chief revenue officer for competitor Cognition -- and everyone is arguing on X about it.

articles.title: Hackers stole millions of US military personnel records during months-long data breach
articles.summary: The Department of Defense notified millions of current and former U.S. military personnel that their personal information had been stolen in a months-long breach.
